title: Symbolic: complete tests of the symbolic user functions
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.5: check which symbolic user functions have tests (symbolicUserFunctionTest, symbolicModuleTest, symbolicUserFunctionCopyTest, ...) and add the missing ones, every signature against its Python version.
releaseNotes: All 30 user function signatures that can be symbolic are tested against their Python versions; postNewtonFunction, the constraintUserFunction of ObjectConnectorCoordinateVector and the outputVariableUserFunction of ObjectUserBody can be symbolic now, and UserFunction.Evaluate takes matrix arguments
